body.p: Claims 21-29, 31-39, 41 and 42 are pending in the application. Claims 21, 22, 31, and 32 have been amended. Claims 30 and 40 have been cancelled without prejudice or disclaimer. New claims 41 and 42 have been added. No new matter has been added.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication of allowable subject matter. While Applicant has not included the limitations of claims 30 and 40 in the respective independent claims 21 and 31 verbatim, Applicant has used the insight in crafting the present amendments. Applicant also has added new claim 41 which is intended to be the allowable claim 24 in independent form. Claim 42 recites the same limitation as claim 23.
Applicant respectfully submits that the claims are in condition for allowance. The Examiner is cordially invited to contact the undersigned if it will facilitate prosecution.
